summary: Fortis Inc., the Canadian regulated electric and gas utility, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) attaching a press release dated October 5, 2026. The release is a scheduling notice: Fortis will report third-quarter 2026 results and a new five-year capital outlook for 2027-2031 on November 3, 2026, followed by a same-day teleconference and webcast hosted by CEO David Hutchens and CFO Jocelyn Perry. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is routine investor-relations scheduling, not a special situation; watch quarterly results and the capital plan, not deal terms.
